items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I remember my brother, Richard, he and his buddy came home one day

ctx.x: Lee, would you tell a little bit how you, when you were a boy at home, how you watched the hired hands, the colored held hands?

Oh, yes. On the plantation in Kentucky when I was a boy. I was born and raised in a plantation in Kentucky. We had help working around our hired hands. And I used to watch the colored people jump around and dance and sing. And I learned a lot by just watching the hired hands and I'd get ideas from them. And when I was quite a small child, I remember my brother, Richard, he and his buddy came home one day and they wanted me to sing. And I don't, I was so small, I don't remember ever singing.
